title: Drive north on Capitol Avenue
summary: The stock Miata approaches the Capitol using the same input and street colliders as normal play. This is one prepared landmark. The neighboring streets retain their ordinary coverage.
measurement: The laser-derived ordinary roof has 0.09 m median vertical error across 1,110 withheld returns from the original survey. The tower envelope has 0.38 m median radial error across 68 withheld returns. The normal northbound drive traveled 42.26 m, reached 13.27 m/s and maintained four wheel contacts.

images.caption: The normal driving camera on the northbound approach
